headline: When to get a pro for appliance installation?
articleBody: While some appliance installations seem straightforward, there are definitely times when calling a professional isn't just convenient, it's crucial. If your new appliance involves gas, water, or complex electrical connections, that's your first big sign. Messing with these can lead to leaks, electrical hazards, or even fire, so proper installation by a licensed expert is non-negotiable for safety. Another indicator is when you have tight cabinetry or specific flooring considerations. You don't want a new dishwasher scratching your brand-new hardwood floors or not fitting perfectly into a custom cabinet opening. Improper setup could void warranties, cause ongoing problems, or even lead to costly repairs down the line. If you're dealing with a built-in unit or anything that requires modification to your home's structure, a professional will ensure everything is done to code and looks great. Basically, if there's any technical complexity, safety risk, or precision required to protect your home and investment, don't hesitate to bring in an expert.
